title: Add Glass Option dropdown to inspection form and display in report views

requirements.summary: Add required "Glass Option" dropdown to the New Vehicle Inspection form and submit it with the inspection payload.
acceptanceCriteria: The dropdown options exactly match: "Rear Wind Shield Glass", "Front Wind Shield Glass", "Left Front Door Glass", "Right Front Door Glass", "Left Rear Door Glass", "Right Rear Door Glass".
Form validation prevents submission if Glass Option is not selected, and the existing validation/toast messaging remains user-friendly and in English.
The `useSubmitInspection` mutation is called with the new `glassOption` field included in the `VehicleInspectionInput` payload.

file_operations.description: Add a new required Select field labeled "Glass Option *" with the exact requested options, store it in component state, validate it before submit (English toast), and include `glassOption` in the object passed to `submitInspection`.

Update frontend type declarations to align with regenerated candid after backend changes so `VehicleInspectionInput.glassOption` and `VehicleInspectionPublic.glassOption` are typed as a string (Text) rather than the current GlassOption variant, preventing frontend type errors.

requirements.summary: Show the selected Glass Option value in inspection detail dialogs and in the formal printable report, with a safe fallback for older records.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/InspectionDetailsDialog.tsx` shows a "Glass Option" row/value for an inspection.
`frontend/src/components/FormalReportView.tsx` includes "Glass Option" in the "Vehicle Information" section (or an equivalent appropriate section) for printing/PDF.
If an older inspection has no value (default), the UI displays a clear English fallback (e.g., "Not specified") without crashing.

file_operations.description: Add a "Glass Option" field to the Vehicle Information display grid. Render a safe, English fallback (e.g., "Not specified") when the value is missing/empty to avoid crashes with older inspections.

Include "Glass Option" within the Vehicle Information section for the printable report. Use the same safe fallback (e.g., "Not specified") when the value is missing/empty so printing/PDF does not break.
